mapper.sql: j.job_id as "jobId", j.report_id as "reportId", r.report_name as "reportName", j.requester_id as "requesterId", j.target_hash as "targetHash", j.status as "status", j.progress_rate as "progressRate", j.total_count as "totalCount", j.success_count as "successCount", j.fail_count as "failCount", j.result_file_ref as "resultFileRef", j.request_id as "requestId", j.requested_at as "requestedAt", j.completed_at as "completedAt"

insert into bulk_report_jobs (report_id, requester_id, target_hash, status, progress_rate, total_count, success_count, fail_count, request_id, requested_at) values (upper(#{request.reportId}), #{userId}, #{request.targetHash}, 'QUEUED', 0, #{totalCount}, 0, 0, #{requestId}, current_timestamp) returning job_id as "jobId", report_id as "reportId", (select report_name from reports where report_id=bulk_report_jobs.report_id) as "reportName", requester_id as "requesterId", target_hash as "targetHash", status, progress_rate as "progressRate", total_count as "totalCount", success_count as "successCount", fail_count as "failCount", result_file_ref as "resultFileRef", request_id as "requestId", requested_at as "requestedAt", completed_at as "completedAt"

mapper.select: update bulk_report_jobs set status='COMPLETED', progress_rate=100, success_count=total_count, fail_count=0, result_file_ref=#{resultFileRef}, completed_at=current_timestamp where job_id=#{jobId} returning job_id as "jobId", report_id as "reportId", (select report_name from reports where report_id=bulk_report_jobs.report_id) as "reportName", requester_id as "requesterId", target_hash as "targetHash", status, progress_rate as "progressRate", total_count as "totalCount", success_count as "successCount", fail_count as "failCount", result_file_ref as "resultFileRef", request_id as "requestId", requested_at as "requestedAt", completed_at as "completedAt"
